decision.reason: The complete original V67 joint trajectory improves photo PSNR by1.36945dB over its2000-step boundary but still trails mature V60 by1.95519dB, with known/unseen measured-CFA deficits1.09623/1.62671dB. Actual native review finds missing cords, attenuated analytic carriers, soft GFX foliage/building/fence detail and mottled saturated magenta. Bright highly saturated hue bias/RMSE regress from the first2k checkpoint. The valid finite10000 state and completed budget do not establish convergence, SOTA or a decisive real-photo advantage. Keep V43 as working reference and preserve V67 as an experimental reconstruction path. No further training-budget extension or production batch/LR change is made by this review.

notes.full427: Both exact-target photographs show less residual grain than the reviewed first2k checkpoint. Sky/facade still retain faint variation and softness. Parachute cords remain absent against the exact synthetic GT; smoother flat color does not establish fine-detail recovery.
notes.known: White/green/black chart and plate shadows show less grain than first2k. A small colored point remains visible in the chart's dark area, while cord/stripe detail stays weak. The independently demosaiced AHD auxiliary reference is not exact RGB GT.
notes.unseen: Brown and tan/red surfaces show substantially less grain than first2k; coarse color variation and soft transitions remain. The independently demosaiced AHD reference is auxiliary, not exact RGB GT.
notes.analytic: The dark period8 carrier is effectively erased. The level0.18 period16 carrier is much fainter than exact GT, with coarse residual variation. The uniform neutral field is smoother but still shows faint spatial/color variation. Lower residual noise alone does not establish recovery of weak texture.
notes.gfx: The sky is much smoother than noisy Malvar but retains faint coarse/color grain. Building truss edges are soft. Leaves retain their overall forms with soft veins, dark shadows and muted color versus the independent low-ISO exposure. The chain-link mesh remains visible but low-contrast and granular, with soft foliage behind it. The independently AHD-demosaiced DSCF3880 ISO100 f/5.6 reference differs in aperture/time/moving subjects and is not exact GT.
notes.three-camera: Q2 shadow rocks are smoothed and soft, broadly similar to the RawNIND comparator in these small regions. Sony fuselage grain decreases, but the faint seam and window boundaries remain soft. GFX50R concrete retains more fine granular texture than the smoother RawNIND comparator; without GT this cannot all be credited as recovered detail. These views do not establish a decisive cross-camera advantage.
notes.colored-CPU: Neutral and fabric-orange fields are smoother than the noisy input, but coarse variation remains. The blue cyclic permutation is smoother than the magenta permutation. Magenta retains pronounced dark mottling despite a perfectly uniform analytic target. CPU FP32 diagnostic contexts are separate from full-frame CUDA inference.
notes.hue-grid: The neutral and orange fields retain faint coarse variation; bright saturated magenta has conspicuous dark mottling and does not reproduce the uniform exact target. The 10000-step grid must not be described as a uniform color improvement over the earlier checkpoint.
notes.gfx-highlights-CPU: The neon crop has far less grain, but fine blue strokes/sign structure remain soft and uneven; time-dependent sign content differs in the independent reference. The platform rails/boundary are smoother and visibly soft against the separate low-ISO exposure. Display clipping at +2EV is not proof of raw sensor clipping. These are CPU FP32 native512 context predictions and cannot substitute for GPU full-frame timing or exact GT.
